status: frozen prior to implementation and evaluation
research_question: Can a policy trained on procedural workshop dependencies reuse a learned action-priority skill in an independently generated maintenance/repair dependency task without target rewards?
shared_engineered_interface: public DAG tasks, candidate action names, their prerequisites, completed action list, active goal, remaining step budget; no simulator secrets or graph membership answer label

train.action_exploration: epsilon 0.3 decaying to 0.05; deterministic per episode

families.workshop: two independent material actions, one join, one deliver; three distractors; shuffled opaque work labels
families.repair: one inspect, two independent fix steps, one certify, one restore; two distractors; shuffled opaque repair labels

methods: source-trained tabular contextual action scorer zero-shot target
public shortest valid plan oracle with full public DAG
learned policy with ancestor feature ablated
metrics: frozen policy SHA256 and restart equivalence
boundaries: No target-family learning or test-reward updates
Public graph ancestor feature is engineered and MUST be disclosed
No hidden required action labels beyond what is inferable from public goal/prerequisites
Score policy trained from public outcomes only
All seeds previously inspected in other experiments, not independent blind; split namespace is distinct
Keep all regressions and strong greedy/oracle controls
No hardware, system tools, credentials, model promotion or private human data
D3/D4 remain open absent unrelated task/representation transfer
